   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      3 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 26 jun 2026 - 3 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Bart Sikkes_, 31 ago 2026, 1/5: "After long time use, login issue errir '9hehw', blocking all access in my devices. This appears to be an issue for many, many people over the last few days (latest update) the same issue!! Roll back to.previous version not possible"
            2. _Kris Bronz_, 15 jul 2026, 1/5: "l'app riscontra un bug e non rimane aperta"
            3. _Christian Kirchhoff_, 17 ago 2026, 2/5: "When I re-open the app after a while and then tap on a note to open it, the whole app freezes. I have to kill it, then start it again, and tap the note again. If then some time passes and later I want to add something to the same note, this all repeats."
